description: This file defines a Dart class `ApiClient` that provides HTTP request methods for interacting with an API, including GET and POST requests. It also defines an exception class `ApiException`. The code manages request headers, including optional authorization tokens, and handles response parsing and error handling.

classes.name: ApiException
classes.description: An exception class representing API errors, carrying HTTP status, message, URI, and optional cause.

classes.name: ApiClient
classes.description: A client class for making HTTP requests to an API, supporting GET and POST methods with configurable headers and token authentication.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request to a specified path, with optional query parameters and headers.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Performs an HTTP POST request with a JSON-encoded body to a specified path, with optional headers and query params.

methods.name: _buildUri
methods.description: Constructs a full URI from the base URL, path, and optional query parameters.

methods.name: _buildHeaders
methods.description: Combines default, passed, and authorization headers for a request.

methods.name: _handleResponse
methods.description: Handles HTTP response, parsing JSON when applicable, and throws exceptions for errors.

methods.name: _safePreview
methods.description: Creates a truncated preview of a string for logging.
